title: Effort holds a template for action in place

statements.text: A template for action is a pattern of brain activity that, held long enough, tends to cause an action. By raising the rate of Process 1 probings, effort makes the brain follow the template instead of the trajectory it would follow without them.

sources.quote: A template for action for some action X is a pattern of physical (brain) activity which if held in place for a sufficiently long time will tend to cause the action X to occur.
that person can, by mental effort, quantum dynamically cause his brain/body to behave in a way that follows a pre-programmed trajectory
